title: YESLIFE 4‑Pack Cooling Towels Review
text: Imagine the heat of a summer run melting into a refreshing breeze around your neck. That’s the promise behind YESLIFE’s four‑pack cooling towels, if you’ll give them a splash first. These towels measure forty by twelve inches, a size big enough to wrap comfortably around a neck or drape over a head. Made from lightweight microfiber, each towel uses a breathable mesh that wicks sweat and cools through evaporation. The brand says the cooling effect can last up to three hours. They’re listed with UPF 50+ sun protection, so they block most ultraviolet rays while you’re outdoors. Each pack includes four colors—blue, grey, green and pink—making it easy to assign a towel to a specific activity. First, soak the towel, wring out excess water, then slip it around your neck. During a yoga session, the narrow shape stays snug without slipping, while the quick‑dry material lets you refresh it between poses. On a camping hike, you can hang the towel over your shoulder; it dries fast enough to re‑wet after a short walk. The cooling effect isn’t instant; you need to wet the towel each time, so it isn’t a grab‑and‑go dry solution. How long it stays cool varies with temperature and humidity, so the three‑hour claim may differ in real conditions. If you enjoy outdoor workouts, travel, or sports where sweat builds up, these towels give a reusable, portable cooling option. If you need a completely dry cooling product or don’t want to re‑wet a towel during long outings, you might look elsewhere. Overall, the YESLIFE cooling towels deliver on the basics: they’re lightweight, reusable and offer decent cooling when kept wet, making them a practical addition to a gym bag or backpack.
